title: Contract rules become a measurable workflow
subtitle: Each workflow state must preserve business requirements from intake through final verification.

nodes.label: Intake
nodes.detail: Capture request details, thresholds, terms, and reviewers

nodes.label: Interpret rules
nodes.detail: Translate policy into forms, templates, and conditions

nodes.label: Route approvals
nodes.detail: Send required reviews according to business policy

nodes.label: Handle exception
nodes.detail: Identify nonstandard cases and surface them for review

nodes.label: Build agreement
nodes.detail: Assemble the contract using approved terms and rules

nodes.label: Verify result
nodes.detail: Check criteria and confirm the finished process works

callouts.label: Explicit criteria
callouts.detail: Tasks are scored against detailed workflow requirements

callouts.label: Whole process
callouts.detail: Correct individual actions are not enough if rules are lost later

callouts.label: Human review
callouts.detail: Exceptions still need professional judgment and oversight

footer: The useful metric is correct end-to-end workflow execution, not plausible output.
